title: G05 D05: dual-arm return, before and after the self-collision guard
prompt: reach out as far as you can and then come back

outcome.text: Before: the return folds the wrist 28 mm into the forearm and fails self-collision, effort and joint-limit gates. After: the same prompt on the same body executes clear of contact in 53.7 s.

notes: Same body, same prompt, identical physics. The left panel is the grounder at commit 5a6c0b3 (bounded curves, no guard), reproducing the frozen fixture exactly; the right is the current grounder. Both are sealed, replayable bundles under docs/results/g05-d05/dual-arm.
